swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: AP7333-33SAG-7 uses SOT-23-3 (3-pin, SA (SOT23)) while TPS7A0233PDBVR uses SOT-23-5 (5-pin, DBV (SOT-23-5)); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs EN), Pin 4 (NONE vs NC), Pin 5 (NONE vs VOUT). Soldering TPS7A0233PDBVR onto a AP7333-33SAG-7 footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: TPS7A0233PDBVR supplies up to 200 mA (p.5) compared to AP7333-33SAG-7 at 300 mA (p.4); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AP7333-33SAG-7 requires Vin,min >= 2 V (p.4) vs 1.5 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP7333-33SAG-7: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C) vs TPS7A0233PDBVR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP7333-33SAG-7 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP7333-33SAG-7 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-3) and TPS7A0233PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs EN), Pin 4 (NONE vs NC), Pin 5 (NONE vs VOUT). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 2 (VOUT vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs EN), Pin 4 (NONE vs NC), Pin 5 (NONE vs VOUT). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 52.8 °C on AP7333-33SAG-7 (θJA 207 °C/W) vs 46.4 °C on TPS7A0233PDBVR (θJA 181.9 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 2200x ratio (55 µA (p.5) vs 0.025 µA (p.6)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP7333-33SAG-7 "SOT23 (SA) Pinout (1=IN, 2=OUT, 3=GND) Conflicts With SOT23R (SR), AP2210N, and LM3480" (p.2) and TPS7A0233PDBVR "Strict 22 uF Maximum Output Capacitance Limit for Loop Stability" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose AP7333-33SAG-7 when load current exceeds 200 mA (up to 300 mA); choose TPS7A0233PDBVR when battery sleep budget demands 0.025 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.2 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
